path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_hearth.deeds: Opens as you tend one home: bring in ripe crops near your bed and sleep the night in it.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_hearth.step1: Crops round your bed grow faster, and the folk there trust you sooner.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_hearth.step2: Crops round your bed grow faster still, and its folk warm to you sooner.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_hearth.step3: Crops round your bed grow faster still, and its folk warm to you sooner.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_hearth.step4: Crops round your bed grow their fastest, and its folk trust you quickest.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_hearth.step5: Use a bell in a fight and your home town's guards come to you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_way.deeds: Opens as you travel the roads between towns.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_way.step1: On roads, sprinting tires your belly less, your horse tires slower, and you gain a golden half-feather.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_way.step2: On roads you tire less still, and gain two golden half-feathers.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_way.step3: On roads you tire less still, and gain three golden half-feathers.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_way.step4: On roads you tire least, and gain four golden half-feathers.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_way.step5: A compass in your hand tells you the way home.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_borrowed.deeds: Opens as you live among folk of other bloods.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_borrowed.step1: You take a quarter of a small gift of the blood you've lived among most.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_borrowed.step2: You take half of that blood's gift.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_borrowed.step3: You take three quarters of that blood's gift.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_borrowed.step4: You take the whole of that blood's gift.
path.jaymoskingdoms.hl_borrowed.step5: You take the gift of the next blood you've lived among, too.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_deep.deeds: Opens as you mine stone and ore below Y 0.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_deep.step1: You mine a little faster the deeper you go, and ores within 4 blocks glint for you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_deep.step2: You mine faster still down deep, and ores within 6 blocks glint for you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_deep.step3: You mine faster still down deep, and ores within 8 blocks glint for you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_deep.step4: You mine fastest down deep, and ores within 10 blocks glint for you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_deep.step5: Loose stone parts under your pickaxe at a touch, and ores within 12 blocks glint for you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_shield.deeds: Opens as you take blows on your shield and stand.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_shield.step1: Blows shift you less, and less again with your shield raised.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_shield.step4: Blows hardly shift you with your shield raised.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_shield.step5: Crouched behind your raised shield, nothing moves you.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_lantern.deeds: Opens as you light the dark: torches and lanterns set down where the sky can't reach.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_lantern.step1: Lights you set down burn longer, and the undead keep 3 blocks back from a lantern in your hand.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_lantern.step2: Your lights burn longer still, and the undead keep 4 blocks back from your lantern.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_lantern.step3: Your lights burn longer still, and the undead keep 5 blocks back from your lantern.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_lantern.step4: Your lights burn longest, and the undead keep 6 blocks back from your lantern.
path.jaymoskingdoms.sb_lantern.step5: Your lantern's light burns the dead, 7 blocks round.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_reef.deeds: Opens as you swim and dive under the water.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_reef.step1: You hold your breath longer and swim faster.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_reef.step2: You hold your breath longer still and swim faster still.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_reef.step3: You hold your breath longer still and swim faster still.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_reef.step4: You hold your breath longest and swim fastest.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_salt.deeds: Opens as you sail aboard ships and fish the sea.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_salt.step1: Fish come 15% keener to your bait, and a ship with you aboard sails 3% faster.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_salt.step2: Fish come 30% keener, and your ship sails 6% faster.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_salt.step3: Fish come 45% keener, and your ship sails 9% faster.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_salt.step4: Fish come 60% keener, and your ship sails 12% faster.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_salt.step5: Fish come 75% keener, your ship sails 15% faster, and squalls calm round her.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_mother.deeds: Opens as you win the Deep Mother's favour: her shrines, her offerings, her deeds.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_mother.step1: Drowned and guardians that come for you sometimes let you be.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_mother.step2: The sea's creatures let you be more often.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_mother.step3: The sea's creatures let you be more often still.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_mother.step4: The sea's creatures mostly let you be, unless you strike them.
path.jaymoskingdoms.tb_mother.step5: Your Tidal Breath brings a surge of tide that throws foes back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.opened: Your blood wakes to a path
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.walked: %s is your path for this life. Each step wakes as a great foe of the ladder falls and you keep living it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.could_have: %s would have opened to you, but you already walk another path in this life.
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.bell_answere: %s hears your bell. Its guards are coming.
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.bell_unheard: No guard of %s is near enough to hear your bell.
message.jaymoskingdoms.path.no_home: You have no bed to call home.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.path.parents: your parent's path, not yet yours
